title: AI智能体设计模式二维框架：认知功能与执行拓扑
summary: 提出一个二维分类框架，结合认知功能（7类）和执行拓扑（6种结构）来系统描述LLM智能体架构。通过7x6矩阵识别27种命名模式，验证了4个真实领域的覆盖性，并总结出5条模式选择的经验法则。提供了一种原则性、框架中立、模型无关的智能体架构设计词汇。
summary_en: Proposes a two-dimensional classification framework combining cognitive function (7 categories) and execution topology (6 structural archetypes) to systematically describe LLM agent architectures. Identifies 27 named patterns via a 7x6 matrix, validates coverage across 4 real-world domains, and derives 5 empirical laws of pattern selection. Provides a principled, framework-neutral, model-agnostic vocabulary for agent architecture design.
